title: Father, Take This Heart Of Mine
firstLine: Father, take this heart of mine,

lines: Father, take this heart of mine,
Now to do Thy will divine;
Help me in the things I do,
Ever to my Lord be true.
Give me wisdom this same day,
So I'll teach someone Thy way;
Let me love as You command,
When this life on earth is o'er,
Take me to that peaceful shore;
